title: Frozen HML_RD factor premium series — the only numbers allowed to size capital
authority: Values copied verbatim from paper_latex/data/publication_snapshot.json (frozen publication artifact). Regenerating the snapshot requires re-freezing this contract; tests pin the values.

annual_hml_premium.label: Headline annual HML_RD premium (July–June formation)
annual_hml_premium.role: SIZING AUTHORITY — conservative bound max(0, mean − 1.96·SE) is zero with these numbers

rd_factor_premium.label: Alternative rd_factor_premium construction
rd_factor_premium.role: SUPPORTING EVIDENCE ONLY — displayed beside the headline, never sizes capital

sizing_rule.mu_claim: max(0, mean_pct_per_year − 1.96 × nw_std_error) of the sizing_series, in %/yr
sizing_rule.f_max: 0.25 × (mu_claim/100) / sigma_book_sq — fractional Kelly on the conservative CI bound
sizing_rule.sigma_source: realized monthly equal-weight returns of the SEALED BUY ledger; requires ≥ 12 sealed months, else UNKNOWN → f_max = 0
sizing_rule.note: No validated edge, no size. With the frozen headline numbers mu_claim = 0 and f_max = 0: the engine says so plainly instead of inventing a bound.

disclosures: The headline premium is not statistically significant (t=1.10); its conservative bound is zero and therefore the sizing bound is zero today.
The alternative construction is significant but is a different series; sizing from the more favourable of two series would be selection bias, so it never sizes.
Neither series is a per-name expected return; both are cross-sectional portfolio premia.
